metadata.title: Lindwall Fe-Al-O: IONIC_LIQ from FactSage ChemSage export
metadata.description: Independent transcription of the first IONIC_LIQ / SUBI block (lines 229-387) in AlFeO_Lindwall.dat. The second ionic block, lines 388-546, is identical and is omitted. Includes all eight endmembers and ten interaction records. See ionic-liquid-source.md for source mapping and representational limits.

phase.name: IONIC_LIQ
phase.description: DAT SUBI model: (Al[+3],Fe[+2]) : (O[-2],Va,AlO1.5,FeO1.5). Va is a vacancy site constituent, not a chemical system component. Its charge=0 below marks the empty composition in the current schema; SUBI gives the vacancy a special effective charge. The raw second-site role values 2,1,0,0 are documented in ionic-liquid-source.md; Va must not be treated as an ordinary neutral oxide.
